notes.title: 39 Days to Mars is now available on the Xbox One!
notes.content:
Dust your top hat, oil your penny farthing, and hunt out that Xbox controller, because:

[h1]39 Days to Mars is now available on the Xbox One![/h1]

Yes, Albert and Baxter are embarking - once again - on their ill-fated adventure. And now you can enjoy it from the comfort of your sofa (assuming you don't already use Steam big picture).

[url=https://www.microsoft.com/p/39-days-to-mars/9nhd9tbk2m03]Buy on the Xbox One Store[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27595138/77c8f152cd8aeba1376e3eef973a773d117fdb90.jpg[/img]

39 Days to Mars is also available at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/504920/39_Days_to_Mars/]25% off on Steam for the next 3 days as part of the Lunar New Year Sale[/url].

I'm also hard at work on the Nintendo Switch version of the game,so keep your ears to the ground and expect to hear an update within the next couple of months.

 - Happy Sailing!
